savicLabsGpu.config.title: SavicLabs GPU Monitor
savicLabsGpu.config.enabled: Enable the GPU monitor in the status bar.
savicLabsGpu.config.pollIntervalMs: How often to poll GPU stats (milliseconds). Lower = more responsive, higher = less CPU usage.
savicLabsGpu.config.alertVramPercent: VRAM usage percentage that triggers a warning notification.
savicLabsGpu.config.alertTempCelsius: GPU temperature (Celsius) that triggers a warning notification.
savicLabsGpu.config.statusBarFormat: Format string for the status bar. Variables: ${name}, ${vramUsed}, ${vramTotal}, ${vramPercent}, ${temp}, ${util}. Example: GPU ${name} · ${vramUsed}/${vramTotal} · ${temp}°C
savicLabsGpu.config.showUtilization: Show GPU compute utilization percentage in the status bar.
